decisionLog.decision: Cold Authority Context loading is exactly three domain queries regardless of selected slot count; warm hits execute only the revision query.
compatibility-pg-live-v1 is a bounded live compatibility identity, not the formal Phase 4 Active Season Manifest.
Store and websim facade adapters remain test-only and dormant until a separately gated Phase 3 route.
